import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 2000;
    static final int GRID_SIZE = 12;
    static final int DIRS = 4;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;

    static int[][] dist = new int[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[][] gridA = new int[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[][] gridB = new int[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] exitPoints = new ArrayList[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];

    static int[] dr = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static class HungarianAlgorithm {
        int matchCount;
        int[] pos = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] rev = new int[MAX_NODES];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_NODES];

        int computeMatching(int n, ArrayList<Integer> adjList[]) {
            matchCount = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
            Arrays.fill(rev, -1);
            for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
                if (augment(u, adjList)) ++matchCount;
            }
            return matchCount;
        }

        private boolean augment(int u, ArrayList<Integer> adjList[]) {
            for (int v : adjList[u]) {
                if (visited[v]) continue;
                visited[v] = true;
                if (rev[v] == -1 || augment(rev[v], adjList)) {
                    pos[u] = v;
                    rev[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int sr, int sc, int n) {
        Queue<Integer> qRow = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qCol = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_SIZE; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID_SIZE; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        qRow.add(sr);
        qCol.add(sc);
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qRow.isEmpty()) {
            sr = qRow.poll();
            sc = qCol.poll();
            for (int d = 0; d < DIRS; ++d) {
                int nr = sr + dr[d], nc = sc + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID_SIZE && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID_SIZE &&
                    gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && dist[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[sr][sc] + 1;
                    qRow.add(nr);
                    qCol.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void expand(int sr, int sc, int count, int maxTime, int[] nodeOffset) {
        int[][] visited = new int[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
        Queue<Integer> qRow = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qCol = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_SIZE; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], -1);
        }
        qRow.add(sr);
        qCol.add(sc);
        visited[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qRow.isEmpty()) {
            sr = qRow.poll();
            sc = qCol.poll();
            if (visited[sr][sc] > Math.min(maxTime, dist[sr][sc])) continue;
            for (int exitIdx : exitPoints[sr][sc]) {
                for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
                    adj[nodeOffset[0] + k].add(exitIdx);
                }
            }
            if (visited[sr][sc] == Math.min(maxTime, dist[sr][sc])) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < DIRS; ++d) {
                int nr = sr + dr[d], nc = sc + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID_SIZE && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID_SIZE &&
                    gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && visited[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    visited[nr][nc] = visited[sr][sc] + 1;
                    qRow.add(nr);
                    qCol.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
        nodeOffset[0] += count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int timeLimit = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_SIZE; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(gridA[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(gridB[i], -1);
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID_SIZE; j++) {
                exitPoints[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        for (int i = GRID_SIZE; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int startR = -1, startC = -1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) gridA[i][j] = c - '0';
                if (c == 'Z') { startR = i; startC = j; }
            }
        }

        bfs(startR, startC, n);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) gridB[i][j] = c - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < gridB[i][j]; ++k) {
                    exitPoints[i][j].add(exitPoints.length == 0 ? 0 : exitPoints[i][j].size());
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < GRID_SIZE; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < GRID_SIZE; ++j)
                if (dist[i][j] < 0) dist[i][j] = INF;

        int[] nodeOffset = {0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (gridA[i][j] > 0) expand(i, j, gridA[i][j], timeLimit, nodeOffset);

        HungarianAlgorithm solver = new HungarianAlgorithm();
        System.out.println(solver.computeMatching(nodeOffset[0], adj));
    }
}
